channel.description: Latest articles from The Oakland Press (theoaklandpress.com)

item.title: Not ‘Just Ken’: Mattel shares Barbie’s longtime boyfriend’s full name
item.description: His full name is Kenneth Sean Carson, according to Mattel.

item.title: Metro Detroiters stage walkouts at schools, businesses to protest ICE enforcement
item.description: Activists advocated for "no work, no school, no shopping" on Friday as a demonstration against Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents' tactics, which have resulted in the shooting deaths of Renee Good and Alex Pretti in Minneapolis.

item.title: Detroit Zoo welcomes new polar bear
item.description: The 13-year-old polar bear, named Kali — pronounced Cull-ee — moved from the Toledo Zoo to Detroit Zoo, where he will share a habitat with two females, Suka, 13, and Haley, 23, zoo officials said.

item.title: Nessel’s office demands Gotion return $23.7M in taxpayer cash
item.description: The demand comes more than four months after the state of Michigan, on Sept. 17, sent Gotion a letter holding the company in default of a $175 million taxpayer incentive agreement.

item.title: More than 60 years after being convicted of fatally beating Oakland County child with hammer, killer resentenced to life in prison
item.description: The child was murdered when she came to the aid of her father who was being attacked by James Gostlin, his former co-worker at Edgewater Amusement Park

item.title: Former ICE spokesman: Agency encouraged Trump propaganda more than facts
item.description: Richard Beam believed in the mission of ICE and in his job to inform the public about the agency. He says that all changed in 2025.

item.title: Young people are protesting ICE and reenacting immigration raids in online gaming platform Roblox
item.description: The behavior could be how children are processing the news and seeking social support.

item.title: Judge calls Justice Department’s statements on slavery exhibit display ‘dangerous’ and ‘horrifying’
item.description: “You can’t erase history once you’ve learned it. It doesn’t work that way,” Rufe said.

item.title: Huge cache of Epstein documents includes emails financier exchanged with wealthy and powerful
item.description: Millions of files remain under wraps, however, drawing criticism from Democrats.

item.title: No. 3 Michigan beats No. 7 Michigan State 83-71, takes sole possession of 1st place in Big Ten
item.description: Yaxel Lendeborg had 26 points and 12 rebounds, Elliot Cadeau scored 17 and Morez Johnson added 12 points to lead No. 3 Michigan to an 83-71 victory over seventh-ranked Michigan State on Friday night.
